summary: Wrote the missing scientific records for two overnight experiment families that had artifacts and no assessment, and finished their exploratory findings. Ran no gameplay: every number was recomputed from the retained artifacts with the repository's own analysis tools (approaches/lifetime-objective/fast-engine/analyze.py through finish.sh, and approaches/lifetime-objective/reveal-sampling/{pool,compare,stats}.py). Family 1, the depth x chance-exactness factorial: verified the fast engine's depth-4 seven-stratum control reproduces the recorded unoptimised arm over 704 field comparisons with 0 mismatches and that the depth-5 five-stratum arm reproduces its recorded 32-game predecessor over 352 comparisons with 0 mismatches across two binaries and two cache capacities; recomputed the paired contrasts (d5s5-d4s5 -8,624 [-55,134] W-T-L 33-0-31 at 23.29x work over 64 complete games; d5s7-d4s7 -1,581 [-173,154] and d5s7-d3s7 +16,622 [-130,027] over the 16 games the still-running arm has written); and established that the apparent 398,498-versus-288,704 gap is the stratum contrast (+101,171 [+47,447] at fixed depth 4), not a depth effect. Family 2, factored reveal sampling: recomputed the depth-4 two-reveal-sample arm at -41,950 [-100,137] W-T-L 28-0-36 for 4.07x the work against the one-sample arm and +59,221 [+9,134] against the frozen five-stratum reference, the near-equal-work equivalence between depth 3 with six reveal samples and depth 4 with one (-22,056 [-89,867], indistinguishable), and the partial twelve-sample arm's -4,495 [-91,425] on its 32 shared seeds. Created the theory, experiment, run and result records for both families with retroactive-registration amendments, froze snapshots of both still-running arms so the records reference immutable bytes, wrote content manifests, extended docs/exploratory/finding-15-depth5-exact-estimator.md with a completion section that withdraws its interim 'depth 5 reverses' verdict as completion-order bias while leaving the original text standing, wrote docs/exploratory/finding-16-factored-reveal-sampling.md, and indexed both. Added a read-only idempotent analysis driver for the reveal-sampling family (finish.sh) and a `partial` mode to its stats.py that pairs an incomplete arm on shared seeds and prints the paired n on every row. Did not kill, wait on, or start any run; did not touch coordinator-owned status documents.

Ran the new approaches/lifetime-objective/reveal-sampling/finish.sh end to end and took every family-2 number from its output; output retained at runs/RUN-20260821T035407Z-00483c6c/reveal-report.txt

Independently recomputed the one-sided 95% upper bounds for the key deltas to check that 'no gain' was not being reported as 'harm': d4 M=2 minus M=1 upper bound +17,541; d5s5 minus d4s5 upper bound +39,052; d5s7 minus d4s7 upper bound +166,299

Confirmed the completed-depth and work-bound audits directly from each artifact's config block: 0 incomplete decisions, 0 decisions below target depth, 0 work-limit events, 0 censored games and 0 score-decomposition identity failures in every arm
Confirmed pooling validity from the retained control: four pooled 16-game chunks reproduce the single 64-game run on all 13 per-game fields with identical summed logical work (312,966,881)
Verified that the pooled depth-4 artifact re-pools byte-identically, and that the two still-running arms' snapshots match the live artifacts at snapshot time
limitations: Analysis and record-writing only. The gameplay, the search implementations, the chunked runner and the original finding-09 and finding-15 drafts are other contributors' work and are not claimed here.
Two of the four runs assessed were still executing when the records were written; both are recorded as partial with their game counts, and neither was killed nor waited on.
The two experiment records are retroactive registrations, disclosed as amendments on the records themselves.

No machine-readable seed-lease record exists for the 0xa5 family; the records point at the prose allocation table in docs/exploratory/lease-map.md. Creating those lease records was outside this work package.
